claims.statement: The northwest Tekong polder adds about 800 ha; sand use was reduced by close to half.
claims.limitations: Geometry is schematic, not surveyed. Public summary does not establish exact component dimensions.

claims.statement: Additional local manoeuvre-training space supports SAF needs and releases mainland land for other uses.
claims.limitations: No assertion of specific base relocations or present training operations.

claims.statement: Dike length is 10 km, crest up to +6 m MSL, and polder land about −1.2 m MSL.
claims.limitations: Rounded public levels, not uniform surveyed elevations. MSL is not chart datum.

claims.statement: Published drainage length is 45 km; pond area 116 ha and storage up to 5 million cubic metres.
claims.limitations: Whole-system public quantities; do not derive exact pond depth or conveyance capacity.

claims.statement: Two pumping stations have distinct recirculation and sea-discharge functions.
claims.limitations: Two stations corroborated by builder; exact division of functions sourced to PUB. No installed pump count inferred.

claims.statement: Sea discharge responds to the pond reaching its preset operating level.
claims.limitations: No numeric threshold, pump capacity or automatic-control algorithm is public here.

claims.statement: Main, secondary, cut-off and seepage drains have separate roles; inlet and outlet structures also appear.

evidence.locator: PDF p1, legend and inlet/outlet captions

claims.limitations: Do not send every external catchment branch through the pond. No claim of complete GIS topology.

claims.statement: PUB operates and maintains the dike and drainage infrastructure.
claims.limitations: Geometry is schematic, not surveyed. Public summary does not establish exact component dimensions.

claims.statement: A cement-bentonite wall limits seepage; a separate drain collects saline ingress for removal.
claims.limitations: Wall corroborated; separated seepage routing is agency-only. Not perfectly impermeable; no thickness/depth invented.

claims.statement: Rock protects the seaward face; grass protects the landward slope against erosion.
claims.limitations: Geometry is schematic, not surveyed. Public summary does not establish exact component dimensions.

claims.statement: Sheet-pile cofferdams provided dry workspaces for outlets before the corresponding dike segment was built.
claims.limitations: Local dependency, not a claim all outlets preceded every dike section. Generic bracing and depth.

claims.statement: Temporary pumps supported construction; cofferdams were removed after permanent protection was established.

evidence.locator: PDF p6, continuation of outlet construction

claims.limitations: Geometry is schematic, not surveyed. Public summary does not establish exact component dimensions.

claims.statement: Automated monitoring supports PUB operation of the drainage system.
claims.limitations: No real telemetry, control-room replica, sensor positions or operational thresholds.

claims.statement: Vertical drains and temporary surcharge accelerated clay consolidation; surveys and investigations checked ground conditions.
claims.limitations: Contractor-only mechanism account. Compress time visibly; no simulated soil test or exact settlement.

claims.statement: Pond dredging and dike upgrades formed part of the marine works.
claims.limitations: Same contractor publications, not independent corroboration. No exact fleet allocation or historic dredging tracks.

claims.statement: Landlocked barges were retrieved using airbags and jacks, moved on modular transporters and relaunched.

evidence.locator: Case body, retrieval and launch sequence

claims.limitations: Single-source specialist account. Optional small schematic inset; no certified lifting plan, load or exact route.

claims.statement: HDB awarded the Areas A/C polder works to the Boskalis–Penta-Ocean joint venture in 2018.
claims.limitations: Two JV partners confirm their own contract; not independent adjudication. Scope excludes other Tekong reclamation.

claims.statement: Surbana Jurong reports a 2017 appointment and collaboration with Royal HaskoningDHV on design and delivery.
claims.limitations: Related-company source. Do not infer every consultant responsibility or reproduce confidential design details.

claims.statement: Main works finished in December 2024; further testing and commissioning followed in 2025.

evidence.locator: PDF p36, Public Infrastructure Projects / Land Reclamation

claims.limitations: Distinguish construction completion, testing and public announcement. No exact military-use opening date established.

claims.statement: NLB records Tekong reclamation in 1981–1985 and a broader expansion approved in 2000.

evidence.locator: Paragraphs beginning MPA also undertook and In 2000

claims.limitations: Institutional historical synthesis. Earlier programme is not the later polder contract.

claims.statement: 1958 and 1965 are pre-polder context; no contemporary polder geometry is asserted.
claims.limitations: Chronological interpretation. No historical coastline dataset has been established for rendering.

claims.statement: Design avoided reclaiming Pulau Unum, retaining a water channel and considering mangrove conservation.

evidence.locator: Creating Spaces for Growth, Pulau Unum paragraph

claims.limitations: Interview evidence of design measures, not proof of zero ecological impact or measured outcomes.

claims.statement: A higher dike crest is an adaptation option; no dated Tekong 2050 construction commitment is established.

evidence.locator: Sustainability in the Present and Beyond

claims.limitations: 2050 geometry, if shown, is explicitly envisioned; no climate prediction or guaranteed protection.

claims.statement: Cutaway spacing, material reveals, animated water and construction playback are authored teaching illustrations.
claims.limitations: Not a digital twin, hydraulic/geotechnical simulator or contractor programme. Evidence supports concepts, not authored shapes.
